short: Classic wooden chess set in light and dark wood
description: A classic wooden chess set with a board and thirty-two pieces, crafted from wood in light and dark wood tones. The photo seems to show a full set of carved wooden chess pieces arranged on the board, plus two extra spare pieces placed on the side.
